case_number: 2024 INSC 997; WRIT PETITION(CIVIL) NO(S). 202 OF 1995; IA NO(S). 41723 OF 2022
summary: Sacred groves/orans conservation; Rajasthan's community-protected forests; ecological, cultural significance; statutory framework; rights of local communities; prevention of deforestation/desertification; community-led conservation models; protection of Oran talab water structures; Bishnoi traditions and historical sacrifices; directions for preservation; suggestions for sustainable management; issue raised through interlocutory application.
final_judgment: Directions issued for protection of Orans; suggestions provided for sustainable management.
